name: evalexpr_rhai
description: Run Rhai scripts inside DuckDB SQL. Rhai is a small, fast Rust-style scripting language with dynamic typing — perfect for embedding logic that's awkward in pure SQL but doesn't merit a UDF. Compile-and-cache constant expressions, pass per-row context.

cta.title: Rhai Scripting in SQL
cta.description: Install evalexpr_rhai to evaluate Rhai expressions and full scripts from inside SQL — column-driven branching, custom math, dynamic rules pulled from the database.
